class.name: JRPGSystemData
class.description: Holds the settings that apply to the whole game: title and game ID, starting party and start position, title screen, system music and sounds, window tone and battle rules.

method.name: generate_game_id
method.description: Returns a new random game ID made of 16 hexadecimal characters.

method.name: get_music
method.description: Returns the music cue of [param slot], or [code]null[/code] if none is set.

method.name: get_sound
method.description: Returns the sound cue of [param slot], or [code]null[/code] if none is set.

method.name: has_start_position
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the player start position has been set.

method.name: set_music
method.description: Sets the music cue of [param slot].

method.name: set_sound
method.description: Sets the sound cue of [param slot].

method.name: validate
method.description: Returns the problems that prevent starting a new game (for example a missing start position), each as a sentence. The array is empty when the project is ready.

members.member: Name of the game's money, shown wherever an amount of money appears.
If [code]true[/code], the title screen draws [member game_title] over the title image.
Identifier that tells this game apart from others, for example for save data. New projects get a random one.
The game's name, shown on the title screen and in the window title.
Music played when the party loses a battle.
Music played on the title screen.
Music played when the party wins a battle.
Sound played when the player chooses something that cannot be used.
Sound played when the player backs out.
Sound played when the cursor moves.
Sound played when the player confirms a choice.
Cell where the player starts a new game.
Direction the player faces at the start of a new game.
ID of the map where a new game starts. [code]0[/code] means not set; a new game cannot start until it is.
Actor IDs of the party at the start of a new game, in order.
Path of the title screen image.
Tint added to the background of every in-game window, each component from -255 to 255.

constants.constant: Sound for choices that cannot be used.
